title: This AI Smart Pen Can Read Handwriting and Answer Questions Instantly #pen #ai #technology #shorts
description:
This AI Smart Pen Can Read Handwriting and Answer Questions Instantly ✍️🤖

What if a pen could read your handwritten question and instantly generate an AI answer without a phone or computer?

A viral video shared by @NonaM_zone appears to show a black smart pen with a built-in screen connected to ChatGPT. The device reads a handwritten question, processes it with AI, and displays an answer directly on the pen.

The technology highlights how artificial intelligence is moving beyond smartphones and computers into everyday physical devices. At the same time, tools like this raise important questions about academic integrity and how schools may need to adapt as AI-powered hardware becomes more accessible.

While the viral video demonstrates a striking concept, its exact product specifications and real-world availability are not independently verified here. The bigger takeaway is clear: AI is becoming increasingly integrated into physical tools that can interact with the world around us.

Would smart AI devices like this change the way exams are designed? 🤔

Media Courtesy: @NonaM_zone
